topicContext: Read complete combined parks, walt and ten related film digests, all four options per question. Cross-category shard search also completed.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: What was the second Disney park at Disneyland Paris Resort called when it opened in 2002?
Which Disney theme park opened Ratatouille: The Adventure in 2014?

findings.rationale: The 2002 park-opening name does not locate the Ratatouille ride within that park in 2014. These ask park identity at opening versus a later attraction location.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: What is the name of the Disney theme park located in Shanghai, China?
Which park was home to TRON Lightcycle Power Run before Magic Kingdom opened its own version in 2023?

findings.rationale: A geographic identification of Shanghai Disneyland does not establish that it received the original TRON coaster. Removed the 2016 clue that matched another park-opening question; attraction placement remains a new fact.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: How many passenger seats are in each Radiator Springs Racers vehicle at Disney California Adventure?
How many different songs can play during the launch coaster portion of EPCOT's Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind, randomly selected each ride?

findings.rationale: Six passenger seats in a Racers vehicle and six Cosmic Rewind songs are unrelated counts. Neither supplies knowledge of the other object being counted.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: In which Disney animated film does Maleficent appear as the villain?
The central castle at Disneyland Park in Paris is named for which princess?

findings.rationale: Maleficent's film identity does not establish which princess Paris chose for its castle. A film villain and a park dedication are different relationships.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: Which 1941 Disney animated feature was made quickly to help the studio recover financially?
Which of these films was still in production during the 1941 Disney animators' strike?
answers: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs

findings.rationale: Dumbo's economical production strategy does not establish that its production overlapped the strike. Retain the distinct labor-history relationship; the final wording does not assert that no other Disney film was in production.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: In what year did Cars Land, home to Radiator Springs Racers, open at Disney California Adventure?
In what year did Grizzly Gulch, home to the Big Grizzly Mountain Runaway Mine Cars coaster, open at Hong Kong Disneyland?

findings.rationale: Cars Land in California and Grizzly Gulch in Hong Kong are separate land openings. Their shared year 2012 is coincidental, not interchangeable evidence.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: What type of ride vehicle system does Remy's Ratatouille Adventure at EPCOT use?
Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance at Hollywood Studios uses what kind of ride vehicle system, meaning guests take a different path almost every time they ride?

findings.rationale: Remy and Rise of the Resistance are different attractions. Knowing one uses trackless vehicles does not establish the other's vehicle system.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: At Tokyo DisneySea's Fantasy Springs, what is the name of the boat ride themed to Tangled?
At Tokyo DisneySea's Fantasy Springs, what is the name of the boat ride that tells the story of Frozen?

findings.rationale: These are separately named boat attractions for different films. Knowing Rapunzel's Lantern Festival does not identify Anna and Elsa's Frozen Journey.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: Which 1959 Disney animated feature used a widescreen Super Technirama 70 process?
The central castle at Disneyland Park in Paris is named for which princess?

findings.rationale: A film's Super Technirama production technology does not establish the dedication of the Paris castle. Shared Sleeping Beauty answer is not the same fact.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: In what year did Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance open at Disneyland Park in California?
In what year did the trackless dark ride 'Enchanted Tale of Beauty and the Beast' open at Tokyo Disneyland?

findings.rationale: California Rise of the Resistance and Tokyo Enchanted Tale of Beauty and the Beast are separate opening events; coincidental year 2020 is not a duplicate fact.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: Including Disney Treasure, how many ships were in Disney Cruise Line's fleet when Treasure began its maiden voyage in December 2024?
How many passenger seats are in each Radiator Springs Racers vehicle at Disney California Adventure?

findings.rationale: December 2024 fleet size and seats in a California ride vehicle count different things. Knowing six ships gives no passenger-capacity evidence.

findings.detail: Could memorizing one answer solve the other without learning a new fact?

questions.question: In what year did Hong Kong Disneyland officially open?
In what month and year did World of Frozen open at Hong Kong Disneyland?

findings.rationale: The resort opened in 2005 and a later land opened in November 2023. The later expansion date is not supplied by the resort-opening fact.

questions.question: Pixar Pier opened in 2018 in a section of which former Disney California Adventure land?

findings.rationale: Pixar Pier is the necessary named subject. Pier alone does not disclose the distinctive former name Paradise; final wording avoids implying the whole former land was replaced.

questions.question: What is the name of the Frozen-themed area within Tokyo DisneySea's Fantasy Springs?

findings.rationale: Frozen identifies the necessary film context; it does not supply the official area name Kingdom. Arendelle and North Mountain alternatives remain plausible settings until the actual area title is known.

questions.question: In 2004, Disney acquired the Muppets and Bear in the Big Blue House characters from which company?

findings.rationale: Company is an ordinary business noun, not the distinctive answer Jim Henson. The agreement specifically excludes Sesame Workshop's assets and identifies Henson as the seller.
